wins: Enumerated perimeter hosts and service versions using masscan and nmap, identifying ssh (22), http (80), and ftp (21) in scope (ep001_step3).
Captured detailed HTTP banner info including server stack and CMS clues, informing subsequent exploitation hypotheses (ep001_step6).
fails: All attempted privilege escalation chains stalled; local user was not able to spawn a root shell after exploiting the http service (ep001_step9).
Persistent access could not be established because post-auth modules (meterpreter persistence) failed to write to disk due to output restrictions (ep001_step10).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance succeeded but the run stalled in post-exploitation; need refined escalation/persistence tactics.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation via http-auth buffer overflow repeatedly failed due to ASLR/NX without supplemental info.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is detected with version info.
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts to capture banner, supported ciphers, and potential user fingerprints.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns CMS-specific headers (e.g., Apache, nginx indicators).
skill_cards.then_action: Launch nikto + gobuster scan focusing on configs, forgotten endpoints, and known CVEs for the CMS.

skill_cards.if_condition: When FTP port 21 is open and vsftpd or ProFTPD version is disclosed.
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt anonymous login and enumerate directories; if writable, drop a web shell for lateral posture.

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase for SSH fingerprinting.

next_experiments.title: Refined kernel exploit workflow
next_experiments.description: Combine gathered version info with local exploit suggester (searchsploit) to identify more accurate privilege escalation payload; test via debug-friendly environment (gdb-attach) before deployment.

next_experiments.title: Implement persistence via scheduled task
next_experiments.description: After re-acquiring limited shell, deploy a non-disk persistence method (e.g., cron job pointing to /tmp) to maintain access without touching protected directories.

next_experiments.title: Validate post-exploitation staging
next_experiments.description: Run post-exploitation checklist (enum4linux, local user enumeration) to confirm the current user context and adjust privilege escalation steps accordingly.
